title: His Hand Is Not Too Short
traveler_why: Beau's gift is courage, and tonight Isaiah teaches that turning back after a wrong choice is the bravest way home.
traveler_about: Beau fits tonight because turning back takes more courage than running. In Beau’s world today: Beau knocks a cup off the counter and hides behind the couch. His chest thumps for a long, long minute. Then he walks out, small and honest, and says, ‘That was me.’ Just like the people Isaiah asked to turn back to Heavenly Father, Beau learned that coming back is always the brave way home.
